abstract: We construct a modeling framework that allows for the flexible contribution of intraday information to predict the conditional distribution of asset returns. A flexible spline specification is proposed to capture the contribution of intraday returns inside GARCH and stochastic volatility specifications for daily returns. The “focused Bayesian” prediction framework is adopted to allow the intraday contribution to the simpler GARCH specification to be trained according to the region of the support that is of interest. An empirical analysis of three broad market indices and ten industrial indices demonstrates the gains from using (i) high-frequency data, (ii) incorporated flexibly into the low-frequency model, and (iii) simpler specifications estimated using a focused Bayes approach.
title: Improved density forecasts using mixed frequency data:A Bayesian approach
title_zh: 使用混合频率数据改进密度预测：一种贝叶斯方法

abstract: We evaluate the effectiveness of randomized interventions aimed at alleviating behavioral barriers—such as maternal stress and psychological strain, limited future-oriented thinking, and information frictions—for early childhood immunization uptake in a sample of Pakistani mothers with infants. A phone-delivered intervention providing light psychological support as well as visualization and planning techniques increases the total number of vaccines received by young children by 0.3, or 7% of the control mean, one year after baseline. We also find that the intervention improves maternal knowledge, attitudes, and perceived returns to vaccination. However, supplementing this intervention with vaccination-related information from influencers does not yield additional benefits in this context.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了旨在缓解行为障碍（如母亲压力和心理紧张、有限的未来导向思维以及信息摩擦）的随机干预措施，在巴基斯坦有婴儿的母亲样本中对早期儿童免疫接种的有效性。一项通过电话提供的干预，包括轻度心理支持以及可视化和规划技巧，在基线一年后，使幼儿接种疫苗的总次数增加了0.3次，相当于对照组平均值的7%。我们还发现，该干预改善了母亲的知识、态度以及对疫苗接种的感知回报。然而，在此背景下，补充来自影响者的疫苗接种相关信息并未带来额外益处。
title: Improving childhood immunization through maternal support: Evidence from a randomized intervention in Pakistan
title_zh: 通过母亲支持改善儿童免疫接种：来自巴基斯坦随机干预项目的证据

abstract: We estimate a large-scale open-economy DSGE model to assess the role of energy commodity prices in euro area inflation and short-run output dynamics. The model features rich pass-through from energy import prices to consumer and producer prices, distinguishing between the role of crude oil and natural gas in the imported energy bundle allocated between production and consumption. Transmission is quantified through direct effects on household energy consumption, indirect effects via energy as an intermediate input, and second-round general-equilibrium effects through, for example, wages and markups. Bayesian estimation suggests that in 2022, shocks to energy import prices alone added about 2 percentage points (pps) to inflation. Integrating broader energy measures in a reduced-form extension increases this contribution to over half of the 2021–22 surge (to around 3 pps). Backward-looking indexation, often associated with wage-price spirals, is estimated to be limited. The post-2020 surge leaves substitution elasticities broadly unchanged but points to a steeper Phillips curve and slightly lower real wage rigidity.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了一个大规模开放经济DSGE模型，以评估能源大宗商品价格在欧元区通胀及短期产出动态中的作用。该模型详细刻画了能源进口价格向消费者价格和生产者价格的传导机制，区分了原油与天然气在进口能源组合中用于生产和消费的不同角色。传导效应通过家庭能源消费的直接作用、能源作为中间投入的间接作用，以及经由工资和加成率等渠道产生的第二轮一般均衡效应进行量化。贝叶斯估计表明，2022年，仅能源进口价格冲击就使通胀上升了约2个百分点。在简化形式的扩展分析中，纳入更广泛的能源指标后，这一贡献增至2021-22年通胀飙升的一半以上（约3个百分点）。与工资-价格螺旋常相关联的后顾式指数化估计作用有限。2020年后的通胀飙升使替代弹性总体保持不变，但指向更陡峭的菲利普斯曲线和略低的实际工资刚性。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control, Volume 189
title: Energy commodity price shocks in the euro area: Evidence from a large-scale structural model
title_zh: 欧元区能源商品价格冲击：基于大规模结构模型的证据

abstract: Countries increasingly participate in informal intergovernmental forums such as the G7, G20, BRICS, and MIKTA. Unlike formal bodies such as the EU and WTO, these informal institutions lack permanent administrative structures and operate without legally binding commitments. Despite their growing prominence, their role in shaping global trade remains insufficiently examined. This study investigates whether these forums reflect structural shifts in the global economy that materially affect trade flows. Using a gravity framework and a dataset covering more than 200 countries (1994–2023), we identify the trade–facilitating effects of informal institutions. Our results show that participation in BRICS, in particular, generates trade gains comparable to those associated with formal regional trade agreements or WTO accession. The findings reveal a novel channel of international economic integration that operates beyond legal commitments.
abstract_zh: 各国日益参与七国集团、二十国集团、金砖国家及MIKTA等非正式政府间论坛。与欧盟和世界贸易组织等正式机构不同，这些非正式制度缺乏常设行政架构，且在不具法律约束力的承诺下运作。尽管其重要性日益凸显，但它们在塑造全球贸易方面的作用仍未得到充分研究。本研究探讨这些论坛是否反映了全球经济中实质性影响贸易流动的结构性转变。利用引力模型框架及涵盖200多个国家（1994-2023年）的数据集，我们识别出非正式制度的贸易促进效应。结果显示，尤其是参与金砖国家，所产生的贸易收益可与正式区域贸易协定或加入世界贸易组织相媲美。研究揭示了一种超越法律承诺的国际经济一体化新渠道。
title: Informal institutions and global trade: Real effects of the elusive
title_zh: 非正式制度与全球贸易：难以捉摸的真实效应

abstract: We examine the impact of public versus private television content on political engagement and accountability during the initial rollout of Canada’s television network in the early 1950s. A policy prohibiting market competition restricted districts to receiving either public or private programming, but never both. While both station types aired the public broadcaster’s national service, private stations bundled this content with local news. We find that exposure to the public broadcaster reduced voter turnout by 2.1 percentage points relative to districts without television, while engagement in private television districts remained indistinguishable from pre-television levels. This lack of engagement weakened re-election incentives and increased the incumbency advantage. Consequently, incumbents in public districts spoke less about their constituencies in parliament and demonstrated greater party loyalty in roll-call votes—results consistent with a significant reduction in political accountability.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了20世纪50年代初加拿大电视网络初步推广期间，公共与私营电视内容对政治参与和问责制的影响。一项禁止市场竞争的政策限制各地区只能接收公共或私营节目，但从未同时接收两者。尽管两种类型的电视台都播出了公共广播公司的全国性服务，但私营电视台将这一内容与本地新闻捆绑在一起。我们发现，与没有电视的地区相比，接触公共广播公司使选民投票率降低了2.1个百分点，而私营电视地区的参与度则与电视出现前水平无显著差异。这种参与度的缺失削弱了连任激励，并增加了在位优势。因此，公共电视地区的在位者在议会中较少谈论其选区事务，并在唱名表决中表现出更强的党派忠诚度——这些结果与政治问责制显著减弱相一致。
title: National content and local political consequences: Evidence from public and private television
title_zh: 国家内容与地方政治后果：来自公共与私营电视的证据

abstract: We give weak conditions for a continuous time optimal control problem with one-dimensional state space to have monotone optimal trajectories. These conditions include a concavity condition on the Lagrange function. If that condition is changed to strict concavity, then all optimal trajectories are monotone.
abstract_zh: 我们给出了在一维状态空间中，连续时间最优控制问题具有单调最优轨迹的弱条件。这些条件包括对拉格朗日函数的凹性要求。若将该条件加强为严格凹性，则所有最优轨迹均为单调的。
title: Monotone optimal trajectories in continuous-time infinite horizon optimal control problems
title_zh: 连续时间无限时域最优控制问题中的单调最优轨迹

abstract: Empirical research suggests that occupational heterogeneity is crucial to explaining labor market outcomes. However, most computable general equilibrium models used to assess energy and environmental policies assume a single labor type that can easily shift from one occupation to another. We evaluate the social cost and incidence implications of labor market heterogeneity via limits it imposes on labor mobility and substitution in the supply and demand of occupations within a computable general equilibrium model. We find that occupational heterogeneity has limited implications for aggregate social costs but plays a key role in how those costs are distributed across households.
abstract_zh: 实证研究表明，职业异质性对于解释劳动力市场结果至关重要。然而，用于评估能源与环境政策的大多数可计算一般均衡模型假设单一劳动类型，能够轻易在不同职业间转换。我们通过在一个可计算一般均衡模型中，对劳动力流动性及职业供需替代性施加限制，评估了劳动力市场异质性对社会成本及其分布的影响。我们发现，职业异质性对总体社会成本的影响有限，但在这些成本如何在不同家庭间分配方面扮演关键角色。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 139
title: Occupational affiliation and the incidence of environmental regulation
title_zh: 职业归属与环境规制的发生率

abstract: We show that US monetary policy is transmitted internationally through the factor structure of exchange rates. Following an easing of monetary policy, investment funds sell safe and buy risky currencies. Global US banks, similarly, tilt their distribution of foreign loan origination toward currencies with greater systematic currency risk. The effects of monetary policy on currency flows and loans persist for several months and feed into the leverage and real investment decisions of firms and, in particular, those that operate using a high-risk currency. We conclude that the risk factor exposure of currencies is a significant channel through which we can understand the international transmission of US monetary policy.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，美国货币政策通过汇率的因子结构在国际间传导。在货币政策宽松之后，投资基金卖出安全货币并买入风险货币。同样，全球美国银行将其外国贷款发放的分布倾向于具有更高系统性货币风险的货币。货币政策对货币流动和贷款的影响持续数月，并渗透到企业的杠杆和实际投资决策中，尤其是那些使用高风险货币运营的企业。我们得出结论，货币的风险因子暴露是理解美国货币政策国际传导的重要渠道。
title: Monetary policy transmission through the exchange rate factor structure
title_zh: 汇率因子结构下的货币政策传导
